text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: share of 210 injected transfers (150 test cards, 60 further cards in the 25% or more, 6 h or more band) labelled visible. Line: 95% Wilson interval. Dashed: the gate's bar of 0.80. Bands under 0.80 are don't-care bands in later scoring.'
text.tspan: Dot: share of 210 injected transfers (150 test cards, 60 further cards in the 25% or more, 6 h or
more band) labelled visible. Line: 95% Wilson interval. Dashed: the gate's bar of 0.80. Bands under
0.80 are don't-care bands in later scoring.
